sections.title: Item 7. MD&A
sections.content:
ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

Net sales increased 12% to $574,785 million in 2023. AWS segment sales were $90,764 million in 2023, compared to $80,096 million in 2022.

North America operating income was $14,877 million in 2023, compared to an operating loss of $(2,847) million in 2022.
